pages.title: Setup and purpose
pages.text: The Wafer Inverter mirrors a completed wafer from left to right. Install it in a sealed, powered cleanroom and place the wafer in its input slot.$(br2)It transforms the input wafer itself, so no blank substrate or extra components are required.

pages.title: Processing
pages.text: Processing takes 100 ticks, or 5 seconds at the normal tick rate. Each tick costs 20 SE multiplied by the wafer tier: 20 SE for SSI through 100 SE for ULSI.$(br2)Leave the output slot free. Nested circuits and east-west pin settings are mirrored too. Poor cleanliness can contaminate the result.
